account_sid.description: The SID of the [Account](https://www.twilio.com/docs/iam/api/account) that created the Query resource.

date_created.description: The date and time in GMT when the resource was created specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

date_updated.description: The date and time in GMT when the resource was last updated specified in [RFC 2822](https://www.ietf.org/rfc/rfc2822.txt) format.

results.description: The natural language analysis results that include the [Task](https://www.twilio.com/docs/autopilot/api/task) recognized and a list of identified [Fields](https://www.twilio.com/docs/autopilot/api/task-field).

language.description: The [ISO language-country](https://docs.oracle.com/cd/E13214_01/wli/docs92/xref/xqisocodes.html) string that specifies the language used by the Query. For example: `en-US`.

sample_sid.description: The SID of an optional reference to the [Sample](https://www.twilio.com/docs/autopilot/api/task-sample) created from the query.

assistant_sid.description: The SID of the [Assistant](https://www.twilio.com/docs/autopilot/api/assistant) that is the parent of the resource.

sid.description: The unique string that we created to identify the Query resource.

status.description: The status of the Query. Can be: `pending-review`, `reviewed`, or `discarded`

url.description: The absolute URL of the Query resource.

source_channel.description: The communication channel from where the end-user input came.
